features_allowed: OHLC price action and ATR/MA-derived regime only; no volume, order flow, volume profile, oscillators, fitted ML, HMM or LSTM

parameters.commission_model: excluded; not supplied by user and not observed; results are optimistic with respect to commission

frozen_signal_definition.long_sweep: low breaches the prior 20-bar low; close reclaims that prior low; close > open
frozen_signal_definition.short_sweep: high breaches the prior 20-bar high; close loses that prior high; close < open
frozen_signal_definition.confirmation: within prior 8 completed bars a same-side sweep/reclaim occurred; current close crosses the prior 5-bar micro-structure level in reversal direction; candle direction agrees
frozen_signal_definition.long_regime: close > 200-bar simple moving average and MA(200) > its value 20 completed bars earlier
frozen_signal_definition.short_regime: close < 200-bar simple moving average and MA(200) < its value 20 completed bars earlier
frozen_signal_definition.chop: all other regime states; entries are hard-blocked
frozen_signal_definition.execution: completed signal from i-1 is executed at open of bar i; ATR from i-1 sizes the position
frozen_signal_definition.intrabar_conflict: if stop and target are both touched within a bar, assume stop first
frozen_signal_definition.overlap: one position at a time; after exit, no new entry on that same bar
frozen_signal_definition.cost_timing: estimated full round-trip spread and slippage cost is debited to normalized equity at entry
